### This 'main' release is an automatically generated snapshot of the `main` branch. It is updated on every push and may be broken or incomplete. The version string ends in `-main.<date>+<commit>`; the mod list shows it as **Realistic Bases [Main]**.

### Install

1. Install **Harmony** ([Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077)
   or [GitHub](https://github.com/pardeike/HarmonyRimWorld/releases/latest)).
2. Quit RimWorld, download the `RealisticBases-<version>.zip` file from **Assets** below and extract it into
   your RimWorld `Mods` folder:
   * **Steam**: right-click RimWorld → `Manage` → `Browse local files` → `Mods`.
   * Windows: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\RimWorld\Mods`
   * Mac: `~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/RimWorld/RimWorldMac.app/Mods`
     (right-click `RimWorldMac.app` → `Show Package Contents`)
   * Linux: `~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/RimWorld/Mods`
3. The path must be `Mods/RealisticBases/About/About.xml`, not `Mods/RealisticBases-<version>/RealisticBases/...`.
   If `Mods/RealisticBases` already exists, delete it first.
4. In the mod list, load **Harmony** first and **Realistic Bases** anywhere after it.

#### Supported RimWorld version: 1.6

The settlement generator is on by default and can be turned off in the mod settings. It changes newly generated
hostile settlements and supported quest sites only; existing maps keep their layout.

**Multiplayer:** host and every client need the same zip (the same version string).
